keyFeatures: Ranks all 24 character strengths across 6 virtues: Wisdom, Courage, Humanity, Justice, Temperance, and Transcendence
Identifies your top signature strengths — the qualities most core to who you are
Grounded in positive psychology research from the VIA Institute on Character
Guidance on how to apply your top strengths more intentionally at work and in relationships
tips: Your top 5 signature strengths are not just things you're good at — they're the qualities that feel most energizing and authentic when you use them.
Try using a signature strength in a new way each day: research shows this practice reliably increases happiness and reduces depression.
